sourceText: Pamoja na kutofikika kwake kwa wastani, “Timbuktu” imekuja kutumika kama sitiari ya nchi za kigeni zilizo mbali sana.
referenceText: Combined with its relative inaccessibility, "Timbuktu" has come to be used as a metaphor for exotic, distant lands.
